title: M1000RR Competition (Sport Black)
description: Representing BMW Motorrad's prowess in the Homologation Superbike class, the BMW Motorrad M1000RR Competition (Sport Black) is tuned for uncompromising circuit performance with laser-guided cornering stability. A 1000cc powerplant pumps out 154 HP and 123 Nm of torque, striking an optimal balance between fuel economy and spirited passing power. With a balanced 790mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort and a comfortable Aggressive Forward Tuck layout, it offers fatigue-free ergonomics whether carving traffic or cruising the open highway.
